#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create a calendar event for a team meeting next Wednesday at 3 PM, 1 hour."""
import datetime
import uuid

now = datetime.datetime.now().astimezone()
today = now.date()

# Next Wednesday: strictly after today (Wednesday = weekday 2)
days_ahead = (2 - today.weekday()) % 7
if days_ahead == 0:
    days_ahead = 7
next_wednesday = today + datetime.timedelta(days=days_ahead)

local_tz = now.tzinfo
start = datetime.datetime.combine(next_wednesday, datetime.time(15, 0), tzinfo=local_tz)
end = start + datetime.timedelta(hours=1)
dtstamp = now.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc)

tzid = local_tz.tzname(start)
if tzid is None:
    tzid = "UTC"

uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@workspace"
lines = [
    "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
    "VERSION:2.0",
    "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN",
    "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
    "METHOD:PUBLISH",
    "BEGIN:VEVENT",
    f"UID:{uid}",
    f"DTSTAMP:{dtstamp.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}",
    f"DTSTART;TZID={tzid}:{start.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')}",
    f"DTEND;TZID={tzid}:{end.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')}",
    "SUMMARY:Team Meeting",
    "DESCRIPTION:Team meeting",
    "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
    "TRANSP:OPAQUE",
    "SEQUENCE:0",
    "BEGIN:VALARM",
    "ACTION:DISPLAY",
    "DESCRIPTION:Team meeting starts in 15 minutes",
    "TRIGGER:-PT15M",
    "END:VALARM",
    "END:VEVENT",
    "END:VCALENDAR",
]

path = "team_meeting.ics"
with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write("\r\n".join(lines) + "\r\n")

print(f"Today: {today.isoformat()} ({today.strftime('%A')})")
print(f"Event date: {next_wednesday.isoformat()} ({next_wednesday.strftime('%A')})")
print(f"Start: {start.isoformat()}")
print(f"End: {end.isoformat()}")
print(f"Timezone: {tzid}")
print(f"File: {path}")
